_comment: Single source of truth for API-key roles and the scopes they grant. Consumed by the Python API (dbcore/rbac.py enforces scopes per endpoint), the Qwik dashboard (role picker on /dashboard/settings) and the MCP server (filters which tools a key can see and call). Keep roles additive: each role is a superset of the previous one.

scopes.links:read: List and read links, QR codes.
scopes.usage:read: Monthly usage counters and plan limits.

editor.label: Editor
editor.description: Viewer, plus create and update links.

admin.label: Admin
admin.description: Editor, plus delete links and read the audit log.
